subject: PreSeed Slate — credit activation plan for CipherHealth
messages:
From: Ava Singh <ava@cipherhealth.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: PreSeed Slate — request to activate trial credits + short extension

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — CipherHealth is excited about trying Redwood for our notes-generation workflow. We ran a couple of quick tests against the hosted API and hit our initial free allotment faster than expected during a live clinician demo last week.

Two asks:
- Can we get an immediate top-up/extension to carry us through a 30-day onboarding window (estimate ~50k additional tokens) so we don’t hit hard limits during our next demo?
- If there’s a short checklist or milestone you need from us to qualify, I can have our engineer send a log and a short integration summary.

Attached a 2-page pitch (cipherhealth_pitch.pdf) and a tiny integration snapshot.

High level: we’re pre-seed, team of 6, demo scheduled for Aug 20 with a small set of provider customers. Happy to loop in my seed investor Emil for any timeline questions — cc’d.

Appreciate any fast path here,

— Ava
Ava Singh
Founder & CEO | CipherHealth
ava@cipherhealth.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: cipherhealth_pitch.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Singh <ava@cipherhealth.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PreSeed Slate — request to activate trial credits + short extension

Hi Ava — thanks for the materials and the context. Appreciate the heads-up on the demo date.

Quick next steps from our side so we can move this same-day:
1) Marissa (program ops) — can you confirm the program credit bucket and whether we can front 50k tokens as a one-time extension for a PreSeed Slate participant?
2) Dev (sales lead) — if we do a provisional top-up, what standard terms do you want included (activation period, usage reporting, small T&Cs)?

Ava — could you do two small things so we can expedite approval:
- Reply with the expected daily token profile for Aug 15–25 (peak day estimate helps).
- Share a short technical log showing the integration call pattern (attachment or paste).

If it helps I can provisionally approve a 30k token top-up today while we gather the details for an additional tranche. I’ll hold off final activation until the log + daily estimates come in.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Thanks Rachel — looping in the playbook here.

Operationally I can sign off on a conditional 50k token extension for CipherHealth under the PreSeed Slate if they accept a 60-day activation window and agree to one quick usage report at day 14. Conditions:
- Activation window: 60 days from the date of the top-up.
- Reporting: CSV export of daily token consumption on day 14.
- Safety: rate limit set to 25 reqs/min until we validate traffic patterns.

I’ve created a draft DocuSign for a short activation addendum — link: https://app.docusign.com/attachments/DOC-99823 (internal). Once signed we can push the top-up. Please file this under HubSpot deal ID D-2026-0432.

Marissa — please prepare a quick invoice note and mark attachments as: requested_usage.csv (we’ll ask CipherHealth to upload).

Dev

- We agree to 60-day activation and the day-14 CSV report.
